pegs.name: Warm hands
pegs.effect: The sock in your hand shows up bigger, so every stitch is easy to see.

pegs.name: Second look
pegs.effect: Tilt a sock in your hand to peek at its heel and toe.
pegs.hint: Turn an inside out sock right side out.

pegs.name: Regular load
pegs.effect: Regular Loads can be picked at the dryer door.

pegs.name: Good toss
pegs.effect: A faint dotted arc shows where your flick will go.

pegs.name: Bigger basket
pegs.effect: Your basket gets a slightly wider rim.
pegs.hint: Finish a Clean Load, with every ball in the basket.

pegs.name: Rainy day
pegs.effect: Adds rain on the window, which you can switch on in settings.

pegs.name: Heavy load
pegs.effect: Heavy Loads can be picked at the dryer door.

pegs.name: Sorting by feel
pegs.effect: Shaking the pile lets the socks settle loosely by color.

pegs.name: Odd eye
pegs.effect: Socks whose mates are waiting in the Odd Bin glow softly on the table.
pegs.hint: Reunite an odd sock with its mate.

pegs.name: Mountain load
pegs.effect: Mountain Loads can be picked at the dryer door.

pegs.name: The hum
pegs.effect: The dryer hum in Laundry Day grows richer and slower.

pegs.name: Knows the drawer
pegs.effect: When you pick up a sock, its real twin glows faintly, so decoys are easier to spot.

pegs.name: Static
pegs.effect: Unlocks Static Cling, a Rush power that pulls the twin of the sock in your hand straight to you.
pegs.hint: In Rush, reach a x5 streak: 12 pairs in a row without a slip.

pegs.name: Dryer sheet
pegs.effect: Unlocks Dryer Sheet, a Rush power that clears the lint fog off the table.

pegs.name: Sock Puppet
pegs.effect: Unlocks Sock Puppet, a Rush power that pairs up the next three pairs and shoots them for you.

pegs.name: Spin Cycle
pegs.effect: Unlocks Spin Cycle, a Rush power that lifts the pile and sets it back down sorted by color.

pegs.name: Empty peg
pegs.effect: Something will hang here one day.
